name: Head Glitches
source:
Everything takes place in a small town in Russia. This is a story about two best friends and classmates, Denis and Nikolay. Both boys share a difficult fate and a troubled past.

[Translated from [url=https://t.me/headglitches/104]Telegram[/url]]
translation:
一切都发生在俄罗斯的一个小镇上。这是关于两个最好的朋友和同学丹尼斯和尼古拉的故事。两个男孩都有着艰难的命运和坎坷的过去。
